tagline: A white strategy-document page ruled by hairlines, with an action title, exhibit badges, a numbered key-message column and a grey implication panel; only the cover is dark.

palette.description: deep navy dominant, one saturated blue accent per exhibit, grey ramp for context

typography.style: specification names Arial for numerals and a compact neutral sans for text; no display face

best_for: Decision papers read at a desk, where each page carries five to seven modules on one grid and the action title states the answer.
avoid_for: Keynote-style talks to a large room; the density is meant for reading, not projecting.
name: Strategy Document
